description.text: Program DescriptionThe major of public service administration aims to train high-level public management professionals with wide caliber, compound and practical abilities for government departments, non-governmental organizations and personnel and administrative organizations of enterprises and institutions. The major of public administration aims to cultivate students' comprehensive analysis ability of current government affairs by comprehensively utilizing the knowledge of economics, politics, sociology and other disciplines.Main coursespublic administration, public policy, human resource management, management secretary, introduction to e-government, administration, public relations, etc.Duration4 years

duration.text: The Public Services Administration at Fujian Medical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3888 USD/per year ￥ 28000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3. High school academic transcript High school graduate certificate 4. Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5. Certification of no criminal record

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid foreign passport and in good health2. Senior high school graduates or with educational background at above level, or equivalent to that of a Chinese senior high school graduate or above, with results of B or above (more than 70 for a hundred-mark system)3. Applicants must possess with a relatively higher level of proficiency in English. Certificates for English learning throughout the primary and high schools or certificate for English proficiency test shall be produced for non-English native speakers.
